memory_candidates: When a Formula constructor is promoted from derived-abbreviation to primitive, defeq breaks can hide in far-downstream call sites (e.g. DenseCompleteness.lean's limit_satisfies_c4 call) that a plan's per-file build-verification pass doesn't anticipate as 'genuine' fixes -- always attempt the reusable MCS/semantic bridge lemma first before assuming a site needs bespoke repair.

Cross-logic embeddings (Temporal -> Bimodal via toBimodal) and semantic-bridge theorems (bimodal_truthAt_toBimodal_iff_temporal_satisfies) are exactly the kind of downstream consumer that breaks mechanically (missing constructor cases) when a sibling logic's Formula type gains new primitive constructors; the fix is almost always to map to the target logic's own classical/derived encoding of the same connective, not to add a new primitive to the target.
